description: What happened between dates for your characters: their texts, matches, second dates (someone said yes, or one was booked), couples moving up a stage, and a character settling on one partner. Newest first, with how many are unread; pass mark_read: true to mark them read, or clear: true to clear them all (after this answer). wait_seconds (up to 50) waits for a new one instead of polling (since: the newest id you've seen; otherwise anything newer than now). Free.

since.description: A notification id from an earlier call: wait for (and return) only what came after it.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long for a new notification (default 0: answer now).

name: my_notifications
title: My notifications
